purpose: Minimal explicit authored quantum source/proof lineage for source-preserving integration; evidence selection only, no new mathematical claim or replay.
destination_semantics: Paths are relative to the integrating artifact root. Retaining research/<campaign>/... under located_prior_capital preserves campaign-relative organization and permits SOURCE_SNAPSHOT references to be resolved against located_prior_capital. Exact original absolute paths remain recorded.
supplied_originals_boundary: These were located in read-only local campaign directories. They are separate from the 47 supplied originals and must not be relabeled as user-supplied inputs or as new worker discoveries.
source_handling: Allowlist only. No original proof file was copied, modified, corrected or replayed by this selection operation.

semantic_gates.original_exact_model: source theorem candidate under named probability imports; retain exact hypotheses
semantic_gates.regularized_extension: separate completed-CPTP and full-patch-floor conditional construction; not original-generator robustness
semantic_gates.finite_checks: finite diagnostics only; excluded diagnostic scripts/receipts are not proof premises

excluded_categories: Acquired external full texts, source tarballs, PDFs, extracted paper texts and datasets
ZIP packages, binary files and bulk archives
Finite diagnostic scripts and detailed replay outputs, because no new replay or universal result is based on them
Superseded failed argument audits not required by the selected canonical proof
Historical-priority literature files, handled by the separate priority audit
closure_boundary: The original SOURCE_SNAPSHOT references 58 inherited files and ADDITIONAL_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT references an older campaign. Those metadata files are preserved exactly, but this selective allowlist does not claim to package every referenced artifact. The eight explicitly selected immediate predecessor files contain the load-bearing model, sweep, topology, lift, decoder and rate arguments. LSS/HT remain named external theorem imports; their acquired full texts are excluded.
